name_story.story: Bakari can be understood through the Arabic form بَكْرِي, whose central sense is bakari; young camel; from abu bakr (swahili form). Bakari is the Swahili form of Arabic بَكْرِي, the relative form of بَكْر, associated with the name of Abu Bakr.

faq.a: Bakari is associated with the Arabic form بَكْرِي, whose core sense is bakari; young camel; from abu bakr (swahili form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Bakari?
faq.a: Bakari is associated with Arabic. Bakari is the Swahili form of Arabic بَكْرِي, the relative form of بَكْر, associated with the name of Abu Bakr.
Yes — the underlying form بَكْرِي is Arabic.
Bakari can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Bakari should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Bakr is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Bakari mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Bakari is rendered بکری and carries the sense بکری، ابوبکر سے منسوب.

faq.q: What does Bakari mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Bakari is rendered بکری and carries the sense بکری، منسوب به ابوبکر.
A romanized syllable approximation is ba-ka-ri. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Bakari?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Bakari, bakari. Script forms are بَكْرِي, بکري, بکری, बकरी.

faq.q: Is Bakari a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
